attempts.exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-workflow-v1-death-knight-metal".

Subject and threat:
- Species: death-knight.
- Threat presentation tier: elite; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade 4.
- Battlefield duty: formation-commander.
- Construction mode: armored-undead.

Identity invariants:
- undead armored commander identity
- skull or death mask
- small command pennant
- deliberate sword guard
- command seal beneath the gorget
- disciplined military posture

Anatomy invariants:
- humanoid biped
- believable armor load paths
- two arms and two legs

Affinity: metal.
Affinity expression: forged anatomy, articulated load-bearing plates, metallic marrow, and controlled fragments
Counterplay cue: Articulated joints or the controlling magnetic core remain materially distinct.
Altered dimensions: material; anatomy; equipment; exposed-counterplay.
Permitted transformations: material; articulation; equipment; exposed weak point.
Prohibited traits: random giant horns; implausibly oversized sword; full-body colored glow; ordinary armor presented as an affinity without transformed construction.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly medieval dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster character concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one subject; entire creature and every extremity visible, centered with finished detail across the canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/undead-v1.png — Fourth subject only: Death Knight identity, command silhouette, armor load paths, and restrained necromancy; do not transfer the sentinel, wraith, or bone mage.
2. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/monster-grade-escalation-v1.png — Pack 2 realistic dark-fantasy finish and neutral presentation only; do not transfer Grade 7 or 10 scale, anatomy, weapons, glow, or the Tower Archmage.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.
